title: WAR: The Visual Challenge
approval: David approved visual feel and touch animations after testing on Android, November 6, 2026
description: Classic offline two-player War on an illustrated red-vs-blue battlefield. Animated simultaneous card reveals, dramatic WAR clashes, sound, particles, two painted themes, and optional autoplay. Portrait and landscape support. No ads or internet required.
